description: Illustrative one-row slice of the §0.60 direction-3 proof ledger: a public derived artefact that was deleted inside a governed, isolated worktree, rebuilt by its attributed writer, and came back byte-identical. The live ledger is internal architecture and stays private; this fixture pins the SHAPE (writer fingerprint binding, sha256 of the reproduced bytes, the one admissible verdict).

proofs.detail: Deleted the artefact and ran scripts/build-derived-rule-packs.mjs; it came back byte-identical (sha256 d6621347e4aa7904a766ab85956e62c413e6ed0f70ddba2a86b0081a6a3def3e). The read-back is a compare, not accumulated state.
